skillset.skill: 13s CT - 3000% Water DMG (PHY). For 8s, reduce enemies' Evasion rate by 20%.
skillset.arts:
17000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase allies' Arts (except self) by 50. For 12s, increase allies' Arts by 3/s (Type A). Additionally, for 12s, increase Water, Light, and Dark allies' Arts by an additional 2/s (Type C).
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type A/C and will not stack with other Type A/C Arts Gen.
skillset.truearts: 30000% Water DMG (PHY). For 25s, reduce enemies' CRI RES, Water RES, Light RES, and Dark RES by 100%.
skillset.superarts: 160000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase allies' next Super Arts DMG by 300%.

passive.ability1: Increase allies' DMG by 60% against Giant Bosses and heal allies' DMG Taken by 20% against Giant Bosses. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: At the start of a Quest, increase Allies' Arts by 50. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
